amy_sales: Heads-up — FinBank asked for an on‑prem POC in a fully locked network (no egress). Delivery via USB is ok. They want details on packaging format, cert rotation, upgrade cadence, emergency hotfixes, and how licensing/metering works for airgapped installs. Can SE/Infra weigh in? cc @devin_se @rahul_enginfra

devin_se: Quick clarifying q: are they expecting an operator-based install (k8s) or a static/tarball install for VMs? Also: sneakernet only or can they allow a controlled jumpbox pull?

amy_sales: Ops PM said USB handoff by their ops team — no outbound pulls allowed. They also flagged audit chain-of-custody and image signing as must-haves.

rahul_enginfra: We can support this. Short plan:
- Deliverable: signed delta bundle (tarball) + manifest + detached signature (ED25519).
- Install paths: operator (recommended) or static manifests for non-k8s.
- Upgrade cadence: recommend quarterly feature/security cadence + monthly hotfix channel for critical CVEs.
- Hotfix flow: customer provides checksum, we produce signed patch bundle.
Example bundle layout:
```
redwood-bundle-v1.2.3.tar.gz
  /images/               <-- OCI tarballs or image blobs
  /manifests/            <-- k8s manifests / operator CRs
  /checksums.txt         <-- SHA256 per file
  /sbom.json             <-- SBOM (CycloneDX)
  /bundle.sig            <-- ED25519 detached signature
  /verify.sh             <-- offline verification script
```
Will need a short "handshake" doc for legal/audit.

sarah_security: +1 on signature + SBOM. Strong preference for HSM-backed signing if they require non-repudiation. We should ship an offline verification script they can run (no network). Telemetry: default to opt-out and document exactly what we collect for audit.

legal_jane: For licensing: we typically ship a time-limited eval license file (local token) for POCs. If they require metering disabled or disguised, we need commercial approval — that changes pricing. Also prepare an addendum for offline support and chain-of-custody expectations.

devin_se: Ops notes to include in the bundle:
- cert rotation: offline rotate flow + ``redwood rotate-certs --export`` so customer can sign with their CA.
- rollback: manifest pinning + ``rollback.sh`` script included.
- offline verification: ``./verify.sh --bundle checksums.txt --sig bundle.sig``.
- hotfix path: support generates a signed patch bundle using the same layout.

deploy-bot: create-playbook: /playbooks/airgap-poc-checklist.md created and assigned to rahul_enginfra, devin_se. Due: 2026-04-03 :spiral_calendar:

amy_sales: Thanks — can you give a rough delta on pricing for the monthly hotfix channel vs quarterlies-only? Customer wants to understand incremental cost if they opt into monthly vetted patches.

devin_se: Ballpark: monthly hotfix channel ~= +15% on top of on‑prem license for continuous packaging + verification support. Emergency SLA (4h) add-on ~= +10%. Finance will provide exact quotes.

rahul_enginfra: I'll produce a sample signed bundle + verify script and drop it to staging (s3 expiring link) by EOD tomorrow. Will also draft the handshake doc for legal to review.

amy_sales: Great — I'll update the customer and schedule a technical working session for Wed. Thanks all!
